summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc., a TSXV/NASDAQ-listed critical minerals developer, filed a Form 6-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing that it signed a definitive agreement with Gold Coast Mining Inc. to acquire 100% of the past-producing Turner Copper-Gold VMS deposit in O'Brien, Oregon. No purchase price, share count, or consideration was disclosed; no board recommendation or advisor was named. The asset is to function as a spoke feeding the company's Springer hub-and-spoke model, with planned transport by rail and a PEA targeted by end-2027. Risk-arb focus: undisclosed consideration, financing capacity, and permitting timeline risk.
